title: Demonstrate accounting in a periodic inventory system

items.concept: Subsequent measurement of inventory/COGS under periodic system — multi-period COGS schedule and inventory roll-forward; initial purchase/freight JEs (gross); settlement of AP; period-end adjusting entries
Number-variant twin — multi-period subsequent measurement COGS schedules; gross-method initial recognition, settlement, and period-end adjusting JEs
Periodic net method — initial recognition at net; settlement with lost discount as Interest Expense; subsequent COGS schedule; period-end adjusting JE
Classification of residual COGS measurement and temporary accounts in a periodic system
